title: Vagus-Hepatic-Creatine axis modulates manic-like behaviors via hippocampal MMP19 upregulation in bipolar disorder
title_zh: 迷走神经-肝脏-肌酸轴通过海马MMP19上调调节双相情感障碍中的躁狂样行为
abstract: Bipolar disorder (BD) is associated with pronounced alterations in peripheral creatine kinase levels; however, the mechanistic basis of this phenomenon remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we conducted a translational study combining clinical assessments in 55 patients with major depressive disorder, 57 BD patients, and 55 healthy controls, alongside sleep deprivation-induced manic-like mouse models. Our findings revealed significantly elevated peripheral creatine concentrations in both BD patients and model mice, which correlated with increased hepatic expression of guanidinoacetate N-methyltransferase (GAMT), a rate-limiting enzyme in creatine biosynthesis. Behavioral experiments in mice showed that exogenous creatine supplementation recapitulated manic-like phenotypes, whereas administration of the creatine analogue β-guanidinopropionic acid (β-GPA) or surgical subdiaphragmatic vagotomy effectively ameliorated these aberrant behaviors. Mechanistically, peripherally derived creatine was found to modulate neural activity independently of blood–brain barrier penetration, acting instead through interleukin-1α (IL-1α)-mediated inflammatory signaling. Transcriptomic analyses further identified hippocampal matrix metalloproteinase-19 (MMP19) as a critical downstream effector, and genetic knockdown experiments confirmed its indispensability in the expression of manic-like behaviors. Collectively, these results delineate a previously unrecognized vagus–liver–creatine–hippocampal axis in BD pathophysiology, highlighting peripheral creatine metabolic routes as actionable targets for therapeutic intervention. Overall, this work provides compelling evidence that peripheral metabolic disturbances can drive central nervous system dysfunction via neuroimmune crosstalk, offering a new conceptual framework for understanding mood disorder etiology.
abstract_zh: 双相情感障碍（BD）与外周肌酸激酶水平的显著改变相关；然而，这种现象的机制基础仍不清楚。为了填补这一空白，我们开展了一项转化研究，结合了55例重度抑郁症患者、57例BD患者和55名健康对照者的临床评估，以及睡眠剥夺诱导的小鼠躁狂样模型。我们发现，BD患者和模型小鼠的外周肌酸浓度均显著升高，且与肝脏中瓜氨酸乙酰甲酰甲胺甲基转移酶（GAMT，肌酸合成的限速酶）表达增加相关。小鼠行为实验表明，外源性肌酸补充会诱导躁狂样表型，而肌酸类似物β-瓜唑丙酸（β-GPA）的给药或横膈下迷走神经切断术均能有效缓解这些异常行为。从机制上看，外周来源的肌酸不依赖于血脑屏障渗透即可调节神经活动，而是通过白细胞介素-1α（IL-1α）介导的炎症信号进行。转录组分析进一步确定海马基质金属蛋白酶-19（MMP19）为关键的下游效应分子，敲除实验证实其对躁狂样行为表达不可或缺。总体而言，这些结果揭示了BD病理生理学中此前未被认识的迷走神经-肝脏-肌酸-海马轴，强调外周肌酸代谢通路是可干预的治疗靶点。本研究提供了有力证据，表明外周代谢紊乱可通过神经免疫互作驱动中枢神经系统功能障碍，为理解情绪障碍的病因提供了新的概念框架。
